summary: Iteration 3 re-test of the fixes from iteration_2, plus a quick regression. All 5 requested items pass. Backend: new test_iteration3_fixes.py with 3 tests, plus the iteration2 suite with 15 tests. 18/18 passed, and the concurrent tests were re-run 3x without flakes. Concurrent same-key POST /api/orders with 3 and 5 parallel requests returns all 200 with a single order id, and stock goes down exactly once. The price-drop notification body reads 'Fiyatı 1.234,50 ₺ → 129,90 ₺ oldu.'. Frontend at 390px: the cookie banner sits at top 132-278px, below the 125px header, and no longer overlaps the sticky add bar (715-784px). elementFromPoint on sticky-add-to-cart hits the button, and clicking it before accepting cookies added the item to the cart (toast shown). The admin status select placeholder 'Durumu değiştir' is white rgb(255,255,255) at opacity 1 on bg rgb(24,24,27). Admin dashboard and all 4 tabs have scrollWidth 390 (no overflow). A kapida_nakit checkout via cart -> /odeme redirected to /siparislerim?yeni=<id> with a success banner.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /odeme directly (deep link or page refresh) always redirects to /sepet, even when the cart has items. On line 32, `if (!cart.items.length && !busy) return <Navigate to=/sepet>` runs before StoreContext has loaded the cart, which starts as EMPTY_CART. Navigating via cart-checkout-button works.

action_items: (Low) CheckoutPage: add a cart-loaded flag in StoreContext and only redirect to /sepet after the cart has loaded, so refreshing /odeme works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still ~909 lines: split it into routers.
Earlier notes still apply: admin_stats revenue will include unpaid online_kart orders, and there is no cleanup/stock restore for abandoned iyzico payments. Address both before enabling iyzico.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested items (1 low-priority deep-link bug found)
